questions.learningObjective: Explain the physical meaning of escape speed
questions.stem: What does escape speed represent physically?

answer.exemplar: It is the minimum speed needed at the surface for an object to reach infinity with zero residual speed, overcoming the body's gravity.

questions.explanation: Escape speed is the initial kinetic energy that exactly equals the gravitational potential energy at the surface. Any less and the object falls back.
